answer: Importing a motor vehicle: safety standards under the Motor Vehicle Safety Act of 1966; forms EPA 3520-1 and HS-7 for CBP clearance; flat duty rate of 3% after the exemption; USMCA covers duty-free treatment of qualifying U.S. goods returned; vehicles under 25 years old must comply with DOT requirements; nonresidents may import a car duty-free for up to one year and it must be exported at the end. Internet purchases: mailed packages over $2,500 may be held at the mail facility until a formal entry is arranged; sellers should attach a CN 22 or CN 23 declaration; the importer (you), not the seller, is liable for duty; materials downloaded from the Internet are not subject to duty.
